verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents queues with a `concurrencyLimit` property on a task's queue, plus concurrency keys for per-user queue logic. Together these let developers queue and throttle executions so they don't overwhelm downstream services. missing for 10: documented time-window rate limiting (e.g. N requests per second), explicit guidance tying queues to downstream rate limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can throttle or queue workflow executions to respect downstream rate limits

citations.quote: You can set the concurrency limit for a task by setting the `concurrencyLimit` property on the task's queue.
With concurrency keys you can create bespoke queue logic for each of your users.
